answer: The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, revoked by a single upheld challenge. The kernel is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the bridge. Reaching the saffron of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short.
